column1: - Capital gains tax applies only to REALIZED (sold) trades. Open positions show unrealized P/L and are not taxed yet.
- Short-term vs long-term is set by hold period: > 365 days = long-term (lower tax).
- Losses are not taxed AND offset realized gains - so 'Net Taxable' nets them before applying the rate.
- Tax rates are estimates based on the assumptions above - your real rate depends on your income/bracket and state.
